spans.s:
nārá, a. belonging to a man, human;
 🞄m. man: pl. water.

nara-ka, m. (n. rare) infernal regions, 🞄hell;
 N. of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa: -pāta, 🞄m. going to hell.
nara-kapāla, m. human skull.

nara‿adhipa, m. lord of men, king, 🞄prince;
 -adhipati, m. id..

nárā-śáṃsa, m. Praise of Men (i. e. 🞄praised by men), m. ep. of Agni, esp. in the 🞄second verse of Āpra-hymns and in the third 🞄of Āprī-hymns;
 ep. of Pūṣan.

nara‿īśa, m. king;
 -īśvara, m. id..
nare-ṣṭhā́, a. serving for a man to 🞄stand on.
nara‿uttama, spv. best of men.

nart-ana, m. dancer;
 n. dance: -śālā, 🞄f. dancing-room.

NARD, Ⅰ. P. narda, roar, yell, cry 🞄(with ac. of sound);
 intv. nānard, sound 🞄aloud.

nard-ita, pp. n. roar, bellow;
 a certain 🞄throw at dice.

narma-garbha, a. containing a jest, 🞄meant in joke;
 -da, a. giving amusement, 🞄granting gladness: ā, f. N. of a river (also 🞄called Revā) now Nerbudda (which rises in 🞄the Vindhya range).
narman, n. jest, sport, fun: in. ṇ-ā, 🞄in jest or fun.
narma-ya, den. P. exhilarate by jesting, 🞄amuse.
narma‿ukti, f. jesting speech.
nārak-in, a., m. id..
nāraṅga, m., ī, f. orange-tree.
nā́rada (or á), m. N., esp. of a Devarṣi, 🞄who often comes down to earth to report 🞄what is going on in heaven, and returns to 🞄recount what is happening on earth.

nārad-īya, a. relating to Nārada;
 🞄n. T. of various works.
nārāca, m. (kind) of arrow: -durdina, n. shower of arrows.
nārāyaṇā-ya, den. Ā. become 🞄or resemble the god Nārāyaṇa.
nā́ri, f. woman, wife.

nā́rī, f. woman, wife: -maya, a. consisting 🞄of women only;
 -yāna, n. carriage for 🞄women.
nārikera, m. cocoa-nut, — tree.
nārmada, a. belonging to the Narmadā.
